$comment: Time-bounded exceptions to the dependency audit (scripts/ci/dependency-audit.mjs). Each one covers one advisory in one package, reached only through `via` for pnpm, until `expires` (at most 120 days ahead). Renew only after re-checking for a fix.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists (<=3.0.3 affected). It is a stack-exhaustion denial of service on deeply nested brace patterns; here braces only expands glob patterns from repository and @wordpress/scripts configuration in the app build and dev-server watchers, never untrusted input, and nothing ships to WordPress sites. Move to the first patched release when one appears.
